items.title: 100 Notes Studio: Pen & Paper
items.content_text: 100 Notes Studio is a private, offline workspace for handwriting, typed notes, PDF markup, page-attached audio recordings and study.

items.title: AI Brief: AI Prompt from Files
items.content_text: Better context. Better answers.

items.title: Aim990: English Exam Prep
items.content_text: Aim990 is a diagnostic English coach for TOEIC Listening & Reading-style study. It is not a question dump: every session you open is prescribed by your own answer evidence.

items.title: BattAI: Battery health score
items.content_text: BattAI BattAI uses five values from public iOS APIs: battery level, charge state, Low Power Mode, whole-device thermal state, and time. Other results are calculated from those readings or added by you. Each detail shows its source and limits.

items.title: CalDaily: Calculator & Themes
items.content_text: A calculator you will actually keep using, because it remembers the thinking behind each number.

items.title: CountDaysNow: Event Counter
items.content_text: Plan backwards from the dates that matter. Countdown Plan gives any event its own preparation steps, such as renew the passport 30 days before a trip or order the cake 7 days before a birthday, and shows what is late, due today, due in the next 7 days and done across all your events.

items.title: CV Desk: ATS Resume
items.content_text: Build an ATS-ready CV that recruiter systems can actually read — entirely on your iPhone. No account, no uploads and no subscription.

items.title: Cyca: Period & Cycle Tracker
items.content_text: Meet Cyca — a calm, private way to understand your cycle.

items.title: DailyMate: Practical Phrases
items.content_text: Know the words but still freeze mid-conversation? DailyMate teaches complete sentences and the natural replies that follow, so you learn what people really say instead of isolated vocabulary. Choose from 8,400 practical phrases in 47 learning languages, organized into 14 everyday topics and 84 real-life situations, from greetings, food and shopping to work, health and travel. A Home Screen widget and a watch app keep one phrase in front of you all day. One purchase. No subscription.

items.title: DailyMate Lite: Speak Today
items.content_text: Be ready when it is your turn to speak. DailyMate Lite turns everyday situations into short cue-and-reply practice in 50 languages. Start free with the Travel topic at Beginner level, then unlock the full library with one purchase. No subscription.

items.title: dB Halo: Sound Meter
items.content_text: Whether it is a condo furnace on a winter night, a neighbour's renovation, a workshop or a hockey arena, dB Halo helps you make sense of sound while processing stays on your devices. The large Halo safety ring shows live dB at a glance, alongside minimum, average, maximum and peak readings and a time-stamped event log. Choose A, C or Z weighting, connect an external microphone and organize multiple calibration profiles for different setups.

items.title: EasyAM: Workday Alarm Clock
items.content_text: Will your alarm ring tomorrow, and should it? EasyAM works it out for you: it rings on workdays and stays quiet on stat holidays and your days off, so you can stop turning alarms off and back on again. EasyAM opens on your next seven days, or 14 on iPad: which mornings will ring, and when.

items.title: Foldable Wallpaper Studio
items.content_text: One wallpaper rarely fits both screens of a foldable, so Foldable Wallpaper Studio makes pairs: a close-up for the tall cover screen and the full panorama for the wide inner screen, cut from the same scene. Every pair is designed for iPhone Duo and saved at exact pixel sizes, so each image fits its screen exactly.

items.title: G+Money: Spending & Budget
items.content_text: G+Money keeps everyday money tracking simple and friendly. Log spending by category, trip or event, set a daily budget and see where your money goes without wrestling with a heavy finance app.

items.title: G+Money Lite: Trip Spending
items.content_text: G+Money Lite — Smart travel currency & expense tracker

items.title: GBAGo: Visual Saves
items.content_text: Apart from three original demo cartridges made by Lumi Studio, GBAGo includes no games or content catalogue. Import through Files only files you created yourself or are authorized to use under applicable law.

items.title: HoursTag Lite: Price in Hours
items.content_text: HoursTag Lite - See the real price of things

items.title: HoursTag: Hours to Buy
items.content_text: What does it really cost? Not just in dollars, but in hours of your life.

items.title: LED Moving Text
items.content_text: Cue Flow handles moments that need more than one sign. Put one message on each line, then step backward or forward live, or choose a 2–20 second timer with optional repeat. Event crews, speakers and queues get a prepared run of messages without leaving the full-screen board.

items.title: LockHour Pro: Block Apps
items.content_text: Give your attention a quiet place to work. LockHour Pro helps you set focused sessions, reduce phone distractions and build routines that make deep work easier to repeat. Ideal for students, professionals and anyone protecting high-value time.

items.title: Lumi Bopomofo
items.content_text: A warm first step into Mandarin Chinese phonics. Lumi Bopomofo teaches Zhuyin through a charming planet-themed game for children ages 3–6. Young learners practise recognizing symbols, sounds, and combinations with cute characters and short activities.

items.title: Lumi Bopomofo Pro: Zhuyin
items.content_text: A warm first step into Mandarin Chinese phonics. Lumi Bopomofo Pro teaches Zhuyin through a charming planet-themed game for children ages 3–6. Young learners practise recognizing symbols, sounds, and combinations with cute characters and short activities.

items.title: Lumi Letters Lite: ABC Kids
items.content_text: Start with the letter A and the first planet, then unlock the rest only if your family loves it. Lumi Letters Lite turns the English alphabet into a starry adventure for ages 3 to 7: children hear each letter's name and sound, trace uppercase and lowercase letters along stroke guides, and collect cute letter friends. A gentle fit for preschool, kindergarten and learning at home. No ads, and it works offline.

items.title: Lumi Letters Pro: ABC Phonics
items.content_text: Real phonics for little learners: hear the sound, find it in the word, trace the letter. Lumi Letters Pro takes kids through 14 planets, 12 question types and 26 collectible letter friends. They listen for the first, middle and last sound of a word, match uppercase and lowercase letters, and trace every letter along stroke guides. In the Parent Zone you can follow progress across four core skills and print a daily worksheet. No ads, no subscription, no data collection, and it works offline, a good fit for preschool, JK and kindergarten.

items.title: Lumi Math Planet: Explorer
items.content_text: Answer a question and a little planet lights up. Lumi Math Planet turns counting, addition, subtraction, times tables, clocks and money into a gentle space adventure for kindergarten and the early grades. All 46 question types are shown in pictures and can be read aloud. Parents can follow progress, practice weak spots and print worksheets with answer keys. No ads, no subscription.

items.title: Lumi Math Pro: Kids Numbers
items.content_text: Turn real mathematical thinking into a gentle space adventure. Lumi Math Pro helps children ages 3–6 practise counting, number sense, addition, patterns, shapes, and logic in short, playful challenges.

items.title: Lumi Mission Planet
items.content_text: Help everyday routines feel gentle, clear and rewarding. Lumi Mission Planet guides children aged 3–6 through brushing teeth, getting dressed, tidying toys, bedtime steps and simple chores. Cute planet missions and star rewards support confidence and responsibility at a calm pace, with no ads and offline play.

items.title: Lumi Mission Planet Pro
items.content_text: Help everyday routines feel gentle, clear and rewarding. Lumi Mission Planet guides children aged 3–6 through brushing teeth, getting dressed, tidying toys, bedtime steps and simple chores. Cute planet missions and star rewards support confidence and responsibility at a calm pace, with no ads and offline play.

items.title: Lumi Weather: What to Wear
items.content_text: Lumi Weather tells you in one glance whether now is a good time to go outside, what to wear, and whether you need an umbrella or sunscreen.

items.title: Mask My File: Remove Your Info
items.content_text: Share safely without losing the context people truly need. Mask My File finds private details before you send a file, permanently hides only what you choose, then reopens and verifies the new copy before showing Private Ready.

items.title: Mochi: Cute Checklist
items.content_text: Mochi makes your to-do list feel cute, calm and easy to keep up with. Add tasks, tap the little circle when you finish, and enjoy the soft satisfaction of seeing your day fall into place.

items.title: Mochi DoneStamp: Last Time
items.content_text: When did you last change the furnace filter, winterize the garden tap, call family, wash the bedding, service the car or back up your cottage photos?

items.title: MoneyTag: Income & Expenses
items.content_text: Every project keeps its own books: income minus expenses is its net result. Here are the questions we hear most often. If yours isn't covered, send us a note — a real person reads every message.

items.title: OnePage PPT: AI Slide Maker
items.content_text: Turn a wall of text into ONE slide people actually read.

items.title: PhotoCream Pro: Film Filters
items.content_text: PhotoCream Pro turns your phone into a cozy film camera and polished photo editor. Shoot warm retro looks with 100+ analog filters, natural grain, and dreamy light leaks, then refine selfies with soft beauty tools.

items.title: PicClear Pro: Photo Cleaner
items.content_text: Free up gigabytes by clearing out the photos you don’t need: duplicates, screenshots, blurry shots and space-hungry videos.

items.title: QR Code Halo: Scan & Create
items.content_text: QR Code Halo acts as soon as a code is read. Scan with the camera or choose a photo, and links open in your browser, passkey sign-in codes and app links go directly to iOS, Wi-Fi codes bring up the iOS Join prompt, and calls, messages, email and places open in their own apps. Contacts and events open the iOS add screen for you to confirm. Text is copied with a short note, and javascript:, data: or file: codes are never opened. To look at each code first, turn off “Run action after scanning” in Settings; batch scan only collects.

items.title: SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks
items.content_text: Save it now. Actually read it later.

items.title: ScanTo Pro: Offline PDF OCR
items.content_text: A document scanner that keeps everything on your device — even OCR.

items.title: Sereno: Sleep & Focus
items.content_text: Sereno turns your phone into a high-end sound machine for sleep, focus, and calm. Rain, ocean, wind, fire and more are real field recordings, blended into 1000+ unique soundscapes and woven together at random as you listen — no fixed loop, just a gentle mix that carries you through the night.

items.title: ShotInbox AI: Sort Screenshots
items.content_text: Your Screenshots, Sorted Find, act on, and clear every screenshot.

items.title: Snapport: Passport & ID Photos
items.content_text: Take passport, visa and ID photos at home — the calm, private way. Snapport prepares the photo only; the document itself is issued by the relevant authority or organization. Snapport gives you common size templates, face-alignment guides, background tools and print-ready layouts, all processed right on your iPhone.

items.title: Snapport Lite: Take ID Photos
items.content_text: Need a photo in an exact size? Snapport Lite crops your portrait to the size you choose, right on your device. Take a new photo or pick one from your library, line up your face with the guides, tidy up the background and export.

items.title: Sono Note
items.content_text: Speak naturally. Walk away with writing you're proud of.

items.title: Stay Clock: Flip Desk Clock
items.content_text: Stay Clock turns your iPhone or iPad into an always-on desk clock you can read from across the room. Big time, a calendar that fits each face, and one look that follows you to StandBy, the Lock Screen, Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch.

items.title: Studydown: Face-Down Timer
items.content_text: See where your effort goes, one activity at a time. Studydown records the time you spend working on a project, reading or practising a skill when you put your phone face down.

items.title: Trip Planet: Kids Quest
items.content_text: Turn every family trip into a tiny space adventure. Long flights, road trips and hotel nights become missions your kids can finish, with collectible rewards and a passport stamp for every vacation they complete. Two parents can share one trip, each on their own device. No ads, no third-party tracking.

items.title: TripBee Lite: Trip Planner
items.content_text: Focus on the journey ahead instead of managing an archive. TripBee Lite is a calm, polished planner for one active trip.

items.title: TripBee Pro: Trip Planner
items.content_text: Plan offline, sync privately with iCloud and invite others to edit a shared trip. One-time purchase, no ads and no tracking.

items.title: Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD
items.content_text: Blurry photo? Make it crystal clear.

items.title: UsageNow: AI Usage Tracker
items.content_text: Hit your AI limit halfway through a task? UsageNow shows how much of each AI plan you have left and exactly when it resets, right on your Home Screen, and warns you before you run out. Built for developers who code with AI agents every day.

items.title: WiFi Aid: Find WiFi Problems
items.content_text: Find the most likely connection problem with independent path, DNS, TCP, TLS, timing and stability checks. Pay once upfront—no subscription, ads or tracking.

items.title: WiFi Aid Lite
items.content_text: Find the real problem. One complete check in total, with any tool, needs no purchase. An optional one-time in-app purchase unlocks unlimited checks and the before/after comparison after a fix—no subscription, ads or tracking.

items.title: Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary
items.content_text: Five words. One minute. A trail you can actually see behind you.

items.title: Wordmate: Learn 44 Languages
items.content_text: Language learning should work across a busy day. Wordmate brings 44 languages, 14 practical topics and three levels to your pocket and your wrist, with an example sentence for every English word and spoken pronunciation. Learn from the interactive Home Screen widget or the watch app. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

items.title: Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z
items.content_text: Zipbox is a paid App Store download. One purchase includes every feature, with no in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads. All 13 formats are handled on your device.
